scripts.start:api-local: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-cli build && bun run apps/api-local/src/main.ts
scripts.experiment:control-plane-mcp: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-cli build && bun run scripts/control-plane-mcp-experiment.ts
scripts.chat:control-plane-mcp: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-cli build && bun run scripts/control-plane-mcp-experiment.ts --interactive
scripts.build:libraries: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-contracts build && bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-core build && bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-api build
scripts.lint:libraries: publint packages/sandbox-contracts && publint packages/sandbox-core && publint packages/sandbox-api
scripts.verify:libraries: bun run build:libraries && bun run lint:libraries && bun run scripts/verify-library-packages.ts
scripts.verify:mcp: bun run build:mcp && publint packages/mcp && bun run scripts/verify-mcp-package.ts
scripts.verify:provider-box: bun run build:provider-box && publint packages/sandbox-provider-box && bun run scripts/verify-provider-box-package.ts
scripts.smoke:mcp-embedded: bun run build:mcp && bun run scripts/embedded-mcp-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:mcp-vercel: bun run build:mcp && bun run scripts/vercel-mcp-smoke.ts
scripts.test: bun run build:libraries && bun run build:provider-box && bun test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:libraries && bun run build:provider-box && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:premerge: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:node-sqlite && git diff --check "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)"..HEAD && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
scripts.check:release: bun run check:premerge && bun run verify:libraries && bun run verify:mcp && bun run verify:provider-box
